# ####MAKE SEURAT OBJECT####
```{r}
## read in arguments following terminal command
# order of arguments 1)gex_sampleID.txt 2)input_dir_counts_matrix 3)output_dir 4)output_name.rds 5)gdo_processing_dir 6)script_folder 7)gdo_sampleID.txt 8) gex to gdo match table
args <- c("gex_sampleID.txt","gex_processing/count","gex_processing/seurat","make_seurat_object.rds","gdo_processing","/brahms/mascioi/perturbsci-pipeline-novaseq/script_folder","gdo_sampleID.txt","/brahms/mascioi/RBP_screen/nascent_experiment/novaseq/full.gex.gdo.colnames.matching.for.making.seurat.object.csv")

############################GEX PROCESSING####################################################

### make gex matrix list and rename col names
n_pcr_samples <- count_lines(args[1])
sample_names <- read.table(args[1])
gdo_names <-read.table(args[7])

# create dir for BP cells counts matrixes
dir.create("gex_processing/count_BP")
dir.create("gex_processing/metadata")
dir.create("gdo_processing/count_BP")
dir.create("seurat_objects")
dir.create("seurat_objects/12_libraries")
## load barcode table
all.bc <- read.csv("/brahms/mascioi/rt_lig_ligrc_sgrnacapt_barcodes.csv")

# convert CSV files to BP cells on disk dirs
for (i in 1:n_pcr_samples) {
  # read in counts
  name <- sample_names$V1[i]
  print(paste0("Processing: ",name))
  c <- fread(file = 
               paste0(args[2],"/",name, "_counts.tsv.gz"),)
  # save rownames
  r.names <- c$gene
  # convert df to matrix then sparse matrix
  c <- Matrix(as.matrix(c[,2:ncol(c)], nrow = nrow(c)), sparse = T)
  # add rownames to sparse matrix
  rownames(c) <- r.names
  # save to on disk BP cells dir
  write_matrix_dir(mat = c, dir = paste0("gex_processing/count_BP/",name))
  # remove to save space
  rm(c)
}

gRNA_df_gene = result[[2]]
gRNA_mat = result[[3]]

                                  sgRNAcapture = substr(gsub(".*\\.","",colnames_gdo) , start = 11 , stop = 20),
                                  lig = substr(gsub(".*\\.","",colnames_gdo) , start = 1 , stop = 10))

# making inner i7 list - need both gex and gdo sample info to correctly combine the pcr rna barcodes

new_gd_colnames <- paste0(gdo_bc_i7ID$GEX, "_" ,gdo_bc_i7ID$lig,gdo_bc_i7ID$sgRNAcapture)
colnames(gRNA_mat) <- new_gd_colnames
```

# Izzy's weighted heatmap analysis - by gene x 4sU
```{r}
fingerprints.by.condition.guide <- readRDS("fingerprints_by_guide_4sU_ctrl_separate.rds")

lam_obj <- CreateSeuratObject(counts=fingerprints.by.condition.guide,data=fingerprints.by.condition.guide)
lam_obj <- ScaleData(lam_obj)
lam_obj <- RunPCA(lam_obj,features=rownames(lam_obj),npcs=30)
emb <- lam_obj@reductions$pca@cell.embeddings
alpha <- 0
sdev <- lam_obj@reductions$pca@stdev          # per-PC standard deviation (sqrt of eigenvalue)
sdev <- sdev[seq_len(ncol(emb))]              # align length to the columns present
emb_rw <- sweep(emb, 2, sdev^alpha, "/")
```
## correlation plot with weighted embeddings
```{r}


## ============================================================
## 2-stage filtering of perturbations:
##   (1) PCA-embedding neighbor filter: max|r_pca| >= 0.6
##   (2) Raw-lambda neighbor filter:    max|r_raw| >= 0.2
## Plot ONE heatmap using PCA-embedding correlations for those
## passing BOTH filters.
## ============================================================

## --------------------------
## Knobs
## --------------------------
npcs          <- 30
min_abs_r_pca <- 0.01   # stage-1 (PCA space)
min_abs_r_raw <- 0.025   # stage-2 (raw lambdas)
hclust_method <- "average"
row_fontsize  <- 0.5

## --------------------------
## 1) Align genes + build Seurat + PCA (perturbations are "cells")
##    lambdas: genes x perturbations
## --------------------------
genes_use <- rownames(fingerprints.by.condition.guide)

lambdas_mat <- as.matrix(fingerprints.by.condition.guide[genes_use, , drop = FALSE])

Z <- emb_rw  # izzy's weighted embeddings

## --------------------------
## 2) Stage-1 filter: PCA-embedding neighbors
## --------------------------
cor_pca_all <- cor(t(Z), method = "pearson")  # perturbation x perturbation
diag(cor_pca_all) <- NA_real_

max_abs_pca <- apply(abs(cor_pca_all), 1, max, na.rm = TRUE)
keep_pca    <- max_abs_pca >= min_abs_r_pca

message(
  "Stage-1 (PCA) kept ", sum(keep_pca), " / ", length(keep_pca),
  " with max|r_pca| >= ", min_abs_r_pca
)

if (sum(keep_pca) < 2) stop("Too few passed PCA neighbor filter. Lower min_abs_r_pca.")

perts_pca <- names(keep_pca)[keep_pca]

## --------------------------
## 3) Stage-2 filter: RAW lambda neighbors, applied within stage-1 set
## --------------------------
lambdas_stage1 <- lambdas_mat[, perts_pca, drop = FALSE]   # genes x perts (stage-1)
cor_raw_stage1 <- cor(lambdas_stage1, method = "pearson")  # perts x perts
diag(cor_raw_stage1) <- NA_real_

max_abs_raw <- apply(abs(cor_raw_stage1), 1, max, na.rm = TRUE)
keep_raw    <- max_abs_raw >= min_abs_r_raw

message(
  "Stage-2 (RAW) kept ", sum(keep_raw), " / ", length(keep_raw),
  " (among stage-1) with max|r_raw| >= ", min_abs_r_raw
)

if (sum(keep_raw) < 2) stop("Too few passed raw-lambda neighbor filter. Lower min_abs_r_raw.")

perts_final <- names(keep_raw)[keep_raw]

## --------------------------
## 4) Final heatmap: PCA correlations (embedding space) for those passing BOTH
##    (recompute on the displayed set for clean quantiles/clustering)
## --------------------------
Z_final <- Z[perts_final, , drop = FALSE]
cor_pca_final <- cor(t(Z_final), method = "pearson")
diag(cor_pca_final) <- 0

hc <- hclust(as.dist(1 - cor_pca_final), method = hclust_method)

q  <- quantile(cor_pca_final, probs = c(0.01, 0.99), na.rm = TRUE)
lo <- max(-1, q[[1]])
hi <- min( 1, q[[2]])
diag(cor_pca_final) <- 1

#################################################
####### plotly version
# Reorder matrix according to your clustering
library(plotly)
#hc <- readRDS("/brahms/mascioi/RBP_screen/novaseq/260120_novaseq/strong_perturbations_hclust.rds")
#cor_pca_final <- readRDS("/brahms/mascioi/RBP_screen/novaseq/260120_novaseq/strong_perturbations_cor_pca_final.rds")

ord <- hc$order
cor_plot <- cor_pca_final[rev(ord), ord]
q  <- quantile(cor_pca_final, probs = c(0.01, 0.99), na.rm = TRUE)
lo <- max(-1, q[[1]])
hi <- min( 1, q[[2]])

p <- plot_ly(
  x = colnames(cor_plot),
  y = rownames(cor_plot),
  z = cor_plot,
  type = "heatmap",
  colorscale = list(
    c(0, "blue"),
    c(0.5, "white"),
    c(1, "red")
  ),
  zmin = -1,
  zmax = 1,
  zmid = 0,
  hovertemplate = paste(
    "Perturbation X: %{x}<br>",
    "Perturbation Y: %{y}<br>",
    "Pearson r: %{z:.3f}<extra></extra>"
  )
) %>%
  layout(
    xaxis = list(
      showticklabels = FALSE
    ),
    yaxis = list(
      tickfont = list(size = 10)  # adjust scaling from ComplexHeatmap
    ),
    title = paste0("PCA-embedding correlations (n=", nrow(cor_plot), ")")
  )
p
saveRDS(p,"/brahms/mascioi/RBP_screen/novaseq/260120_novaseq/plotly_obj_1402_strong_perturbations_weighted_pca_embeddings_heatmap.rds")
#p <- readRDS("plotly_obj_1402_strong_perturbations_heatmap.rds")
```

# #### lambda mixscape ####
```{r}
source("/brahms/mascioi/common_analysis_functions.R")
library(irlba)
library(Matrix)
options(future.globals.maxSize = 10 * 1024^3)  # 10 GB

assigned.obj <- readRDS("seurat_objects/260817_assigned_cells_only.rds")
assigned.obj <- SCTransform_rewrite(assigned.obj, return.only.var.genes=FALSE, verbose = T)
perturbations <- sort(unique(assigned.obj$entropy.gene))
perturbations <- perturbations[perturbations != "NT" & perturbations != "Unassigned"]
Idents(assigned.obj) <- "entropy.gene"
  
total.lambda <- readRDS("fingerprints_by_gene.rds")
total.lambda <- total.lambda$fingerprints$Lambdas
residuals <- GetResiduals2(assigned.obj, "entropy.gene", "NT", total.lambda)
  
# projecting each perturbation 
projection.list <- list()
for (j in 1:length(perturbations)) {
  pt.res <- residuals[,WhichCells(assigned.obj,idents = c(perturbations[j],"NT"))]
  projection.list[[j]] <- ProjectResiduals2(pt.res, total.lambda[,perturbations[j]])
  names(projection.list)[j] <- perturbations[j]
}
  

saveRDS(projection.list, "lambda_mixscape_projections_for_all_cells.rds")



assigned.obj$lmix.model <- "NT"


full.obj.meta <- assigned.obj[[]]

for (p in 1:length(names(projection.list))) {
  target <- names(projection.list)[p]
  print(paste0("modeling perturbation: ",target," - ",Sys.time()))
  target.projections <- projection.list[[target]]
  target.projections <- as.data.frame(cbind(target.projections,full.obj.meta[rownames(target.projections),"entropy.gene"]))
  colnames(target.projections) <- c("projection","perturbation")
  target.projections$projection <- as.numeric(target.projections$projection)
  model.result <- em_fixed_gauss_gamma_with_labels(data = target.projections[target.projections$perturbation != "NT",],
                                                   fixed_mean = mean(target.projections$projection[target.projections$perturbation == "NT"]), 
                                                   fixed_sd = sd(target.projections$projection[target.projections$perturbation == "NT"]), 
                                                   column = "projection")
  assigned.obj$lmix.model[model.result$classification$cell] <- model.result$classification$predicted_class
}
print(paste0("done! - ", Sys.time()))
table(assigned.obj$lmix.model)

table(assigned.obj$lmix.model, assigned.obj$ctrl_4sU)

assigned.obj$lmix.gene <- paste0(assigned.obj$entropy.gene,"_",assigned.obj$lmix.model)
assigned.obj$lmix.guide <- paste0(assigned.obj$entropy.guide,"_",assigned.obj$lmix.model)
DefaultAssay(assigned.obj) <- "RNA"
assigned.obj[["SCT"]] <- NULL
saveRDS(assigned.obj, "seurat_objects/260818_guide_assigned_cells_lmix.rds")
kd.obj <- subset(assigned.obj, lmix.model != "NP")
saveRDS(kd.obj, "seurat_objects/260818_kd_cells_only.rds")
kd.obj
```

## heatmaps with these fingerprints

```{r}
guide.fingerprints <- readRDS("fingerprints_by_guide_4sU_ctrl_separate_RBP_KD_cells_only.rds")

lam_obj <- CreateSeuratObject(counts=guide.fingerprints,data=guide.fingerprints)
#lam_obj <- CreateSeuratObject(counts=guide.fingerprints$fingerprints$Lambdas,data=guide.fingerprints$fingerprints$Lambdas)
lam_obj <- ScaleData(lam_obj)
lam_obj <- RunPCA(lam_obj,features=rownames(lam_obj),npcs=30)
emb <- lam_obj@reductions$pca@cell.embeddings
alpha <- 0.7
sdev <- lam_obj@reductions$pca@stdev          # per-PC standard deviation (sqrt of eigenvalue)
sdev <- sdev[seq_len(ncol(emb))]              # align length to the columns present
emb_rw <- sweep(emb, 2, sdev^alpha, "/")


## ============================================================
## 2-stage filtering of perturbations:
##   (1) PCA-embedding neighbor filter: max|r_pca| >= 0.6
##   (2) Raw-lambda neighbor filter:    max|r_raw| >= 0.2
## Plot ONE heatmap using PCA-embedding correlations for those
## passing BOTH filters.
## ============================================================

## --------------------------
## Knobs
## --------------------------
npcs          <- 30
min_abs_r_pca <- 0.01   # stage-1 (PCA space)
min_abs_r_raw <- 0.025   # stage-2 (raw lambdas)
hclust_method <- "average"
row_fontsize  <- 0.5

## --------------------------
## 1) Align genes + build Seurat + PCA (perturbations are "cells")
##    lambdas: genes x perturbations
## --------------------------
#genes_use <- rownames(guide.fingerprints$fingerprints$Lambdas)

#lambdas_mat <- as.matrix(guide.fingerprints$fingerprints$Lambdas[genes_use, , drop = FALSE])

genes_use <- rownames(guide.fingerprints)

lambdas_mat <- as.matrix(guide.fingerprints[genes_use, , drop = FALSE])

Z <- emb_rw  # izzy's weighted embeddings

## --------------------------
## 2) Stage-1 filter: PCA-embedding neighbors
## --------------------------
cor_pca_all <- cor(t(Z), method = "pearson")  # perturbation x perturbation
diag(cor_pca_all) <- NA_real_

max_abs_pca <- apply(abs(cor_pca_all), 1, max, na.rm = TRUE)
keep_pca    <- max_abs_pca >= min_abs_r_pca

message(
  "Stage-1 (PCA) kept ", sum(keep_pca), " / ", length(keep_pca),
  " with max|r_pca| >= ", min_abs_r_pca
)

if (sum(keep_pca) < 2) stop("Too few passed PCA neighbor filter. Lower min_abs_r_pca.")

perts_pca <- names(keep_pca)[keep_pca]

## --------------------------
## 3) Stage-2 filter: RAW lambda neighbors, applied within stage-1 set
## --------------------------
lambdas_stage1 <- lambdas_mat[, perts_pca, drop = FALSE]   # genes x perts (stage-1)
cor_raw_stage1 <- cor(lambdas_stage1, method = "pearson")  # perts x perts
diag(cor_raw_stage1) <- NA_real_

max_abs_raw <- apply(abs(cor_raw_stage1), 1, max, na.rm = TRUE)
keep_raw    <- max_abs_raw >= min_abs_r_raw

message(
  "Stage-2 (RAW) kept ", sum(keep_raw), " / ", length(keep_raw),
  " (among stage-1) with max|r_raw| >= ", min_abs_r_raw
)

if (sum(keep_raw) < 2) stop("Too few passed raw-lambda neighbor filter. Lower min_abs_r_raw.")

perts_final <- names(keep_raw)[keep_raw]

## --------------------------
## 4) Final heatmap: PCA correlations (embedding space) for those passing BOTH
##    (recompute on the displayed set for clean quantiles/clustering)
## --------------------------
Z_final <- Z[perts_final, , drop = FALSE]
cor_pca_final <- cor(t(Z_final), method = "pearson")
diag(cor_pca_final) <- 0

hc <- hclust(as.dist(1 - cor_pca_final), method = hclust_method)

q  <- quantile(cor_pca_final, probs = c(0.01, 0.99), na.rm = TRUE)
lo <- max(-1, q[[1]])
hi <- min( 1, q[[2]])
diag(cor_pca_final) <- 1

#################################################
####### plotly version
# Reorder matrix according to your clustering
library(plotly)
#hc <- readRDS("/brahms/mascioi/RBP_screen/novaseq/260120_novaseq/strong_perturbations_hclust.rds")
#cor_pca_final <- readRDS("/brahms/mascioi/RBP_screen/novaseq/260120_novaseq/strong_perturbations_cor_pca_final.rds")

ord <- hc$order
cor_plot <- cor_pca_final[rev(ord), ord]
q  <- quantile(cor_pca_final, probs = c(0.01, 0.99), na.rm = TRUE)
lo <- max(-1, q[[1]])
hi <- min( 1, q[[2]])

p <- plot_ly(
  x = colnames(cor_plot),
  y = rownames(cor_plot),
  z = cor_plot,
  type = "heatmap",
  colorscale = list(
    c(0, "blue"),
    c(0.5, "white"),
    c(1, "red")
  ),
  zmin = -1,
  zmax = 1,
  zmid = 0,
  hovertemplate = paste(
    "Perturbation X: %{x}<br>",
    "Perturbation Y: %{y}<br>",
    "Pearson r: %{z:.3f}<extra></extra>"
  )
) %>%
  layout(
    xaxis = list(
      showticklabels = FALSE
    ),
    yaxis = list(
      tickfont = list(size = 7)  # adjust scaling from ComplexHeatmap
    ),
    title = paste0("PCA-embedding correlations (n=", nrow(cor_plot), ")")
  )
p
```
## ### fingerprinting to RBP fingerprints
```{r}
assigned.obj <- readRDS("seurat_objects/260904_guide_assigned_cells_lmix_both_self_and_RBP.rds")
DefaultAssay(assigned.obj) <- "RNA"


total.lambda <- readRDS("/brahms/mascioi/RBP_screen/novaseq/260120_novaseq/fingerprints/full.perturbation.dictionary.w.lambdas.and.dists.rds")
total.lambda$Lambdas <- total.lambda$Lambdas[,unique(assigned.obj$entropy.gene)[unique(assigned.obj$entropy.gene) != "NT"]]
rbp.fingerprints <- list(fingerprints = total.lambda)

assigned.obj <- SCTransform_rewrite(assigned.obj, return.only.var.genes = FALSE)

assigned.obj <- FingerprintCells(assigned.obj, condition_meta = 'entropy.gene', control_class = 'NT', dictionary = rbp.fingerprints, group_level = FALSE, mc.cores = 12)

cell_level_summary <- SummarizeResults(assigned.obj, group_level = FALSE,
                                       condition_meta = 'entropy.gene',
```

```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(patchwork)

fp <- readRDS("fingerprints_by_gene_x_4sU.rds")
lambda <- as.matrix(fp$fingerprints$Lambdas)

DefaultAssay(kd.obj) <- "RNA"

## Pick top genes from each fingerprint
top_n <- 50

get_top_genes <- function(lambda, fp_name, n = 25) {
  x <- lambda[, fp_name]
  x <- x[!is.na(x)]

  up <- names(sort(x, decreasing = TRUE))[seq_len(n)]
  down <- names(sort(x, decreasing = FALSE))[seq_len(n)]

  list(
    up = up,
    down = down,
    ordered = c(up, rev(down))
  )
}

nudc_4su_genes <- get_top_genes(lambda, "NUDC-4sU", top_n)
nudc_ctrl_genes <- get_top_genes(lambda, "NUDC-control", top_n)

## Single-cell object for plotting:
## NUDC KD cells + NT cells
hm.obj <- subset(
  kd.obj,
  subset = entropy.gene == "NT" |
    (entropy.gene == "NUDC" & lmix.model == "KD")
)

## Group by perturbation x 4sU status

Idents(hm.obj) <- "gene_4sU"

## Optional but useful: enforce group order
group_order <- c("NUDC_control", "NUDC_4sU", "NT_control", "NT_4sU")
hm.obj$gene_4sU <- factor(
  hm.obj$gene_4sU,
  levels = group_order
)


## Scale only genes that will be plotted
features_use <- unique(c(nudc_4su_genes$ordered, nudc_ctrl_genes$ordered))
features_use <- intersect(features_use, rownames(hm.obj))

hm.obj <- NormalizeData(hm.obj)

hm.obj <- ScaleData(
  hm.obj,
  features = features_use,
  assay = "RNA"
)

## Heatmap for genes selected from the NUDC_4sU fingerprint
p_4su <- DoHeatmap(
  hm.obj,
  features = intersect(nudc_4su_genes$ordered, rownames(hm.obj)),
  group.by = "gene_4sU",
  assay = "RNA",
  disp.min = -2.5,
  disp.max = 2.5,
  label = TRUE
) +
  ggtitle("Top up/down genes from NUDC_4sU fingerprint")

## Heatmap for genes selected from the NUDC_ctrl fingerprint
p_ctrl <- DoHeatmap(
  hm.obj,
  features = intersect(nudc_ctrl_genes$ordered, rownames(hm.obj)),
  group.by = "gene_4sU",
  assay = "RNA",
  disp.min = -2.5,
  disp.max = 2.5,
  label = TRUE
) +
  ggtitle("Top up/down genes from NUDC_ctrl fingerprint")

p_4su
p_ctrl

#If you want one combined heatmap instead:

combined_genes <- unique(c(
  nudc_4su_genes$ordered,
  nudc_ctrl_genes$ordered
))

combined_genes <- intersect(combined_genes, rownames(hm.obj))

DoHeatmap(
  hm.obj,
  features = combined_genes,
  group.by = "gene_4sU",
  assay = "RNA",
  disp.min = -2.5,
  disp.max = 2.5,
  label = TRUE
) +
  ggtitle("Top up/down genes from NUDC_4sU and NUDC_ctrl fingerprints")
```

```{r}
nascent <- readRDS("seurat_objects/260818_kd_cells_only.rds")
rbp <- readRDS("/brahms/mascioi/RBP_screen/novaseq/260120_novaseq/seurat_objects/260603_kd_mixed_entropy_labels_with_37_clusters_metadat.rds")
sort(table(rbp$entropy.mixed.gene)[c(unique(nascent$entropy.gene),"NO-TARGET")], decreasing = T)
Idents(rbp) <- "entropy.mixed.gene"
rbp <- subset(rbp, entropy.mixed.gene %in% c(unique(nascent$entropy.gene), "NO-TARGET"), downsample = 1000)

rbp <- NormalizeData(rbp)
DefaultAssay(nascent) <- "RNA"
nascent <- NormalizeData(nascent)


DE.perturbations <- c("NUDC", "CPSF1", "CSTF3")
DE.sig <- data.frame(NULL)
DE.40 <- data.frame(NULL)

for (i in 2:length(DE.perturbations)) {
  gene <- DE.perturbations[i]
  print(gene)
  x <- FindMarkers(rbp, group.by = "entropy.mixed.gene", ident.1 = gene, ident.2 = "NO-TARGET")
  x$pct.diff <- x$pct.1 - x$pct.2
  x$perturbation <- gene
  x$genes <- rownames(x)
  x <- x %>% dplyr::filter(p_val_adj <= 0.05)
  x <- x %>% dplyr::filter(genes %in% Features(nascent))
  DE.sig <- rbind(DE.sig,x)
  
  x <- x %>% arrange(desc(abs(avg_log2FC))) %>% head(n = 40)
  DE.40 <- rbind(DE.40,x)
  rm(x)
}

rbp.sub <- subset(rbp, entropy.mixed.gene %in% c("NUDC", "CPSF1", "CSTF3", "NO-TARGET"))
rbp.sub <- ScaleData(rbp.sub, features = unique(DE.40$genes))

DE.perturbations <- c("CPSF1", "CSTF3","NUDC")
features.to.plot <- c()
for (i in 1:length(DE.perturbations)) {
  prtb <- DE.perturbations[i]
  print(prtb)
  gene.names <- cpa.fingerprints %>% arrange(desc(abs(.data[[prtb]]))) %>% head(n=50) %>% rownames()
  sub <- cpa.fingerprints[gene.names,]
  ordered.genes <- sub %>% arrange(desc(.data[[prtb]])) %>% rownames
  features.to.plot <- c(features.to.plot, ordered.genes[!(ordered.genes %in% features.to.plot)])
  rm(gene.names,sub, ordered.genes)
}

DefaultAssay(rbp.sub) <- "RNA"
```

```{r}
library(data.table)
library(Matrix)
library(Seurat)

nascent <- readRDS("seurat_objects/260818_kd_cells_only.rds")

nascent.count.files <- list.files(
  "gex_processing/nascent_count_bulk_ref",
  full.names = TRUE
)

sampleID <- basename(nascent.count.files)
sampleID <- gsub("_nascent_counts.tsv.gz", "", sampleID)

cell.keep <- Cells(nascent)

triplets <- vector("list", length(nascent.count.files))

for (i in seq_along(nascent.count.files)) {
  print(paste0("Sample number ",i," of ",length(nascent.count.files)))
  dt <- fread(nascent.count.files[i])
  
  # Rename non-gene columns to sample-prefixed cell names
  count.cols <- setdiff(names(dt), "gene")
  setnames(
    dt,
    old = count.cols,
    new = paste0(sampleID[i], "_", count.cols)
  )

  # Keep only cells present in the Seurat object
  keep.cols <- intersect(names(dt), cell.keep)
  dt <- dt[, c("gene", keep.cols), with = FALSE]

  # Convert wide counts to long sparse triplets
  long <- melt(
    dt,
    id.vars = "gene",
    variable.name = "cell",
    value.name = "count",
    variable.factor = FALSE
  )

  # Keep only nonzero, non-missing values
  long <- long[!is.na(count) & count != 0]

  triplets[[i]] <- long
}
rm(dt, long, count.cols, keep.cols)

triplets <- rbindlist(triplets)

genes <- unique(triplets$gene)
cells <- cell.keep[cell.keep %in% unique(triplets$cell)]

nascent.sparse <- sparseMatrix(
  i = match(triplets$gene, genes),
  j = match(triplets$cell, cells),
  x = triplets$count,
  dims = c(length(genes), length(cells)),
  dimnames = list(genes, cells)
)

nascent[["nascent"]] <- CreateAssay5Object(counts = nascent.sparse)

VlnPlot(
  nascent,
  assay = "nascent",
  group.by = "entropy.label",
  features = c("nCount_RNA","nCount_nascent"),
  log = TRUE,
  pt.size = 0
)

rm(triplets)
gc()


saveRDS(nascent, "seurat_objects/260901_kd_cells_w_nascent_counts_bulk_ref.rds")

rm(nascent, nascent.sparse, nascent.count.files, cell.keep,cells,i,sampleID)
gc()
```


## calculating rates
uses the differential equations from perturbsci kinetics

This gives you beta (degradation rate) and alpha (synthesis rate) matrices, genes × pseudo-cell-groups, with NA for genes that failed the validity filter in that group.
```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(Matrix)

t <- 2  # hours of 4sU labeling
obj <- readRDS("seurat_objects/260901_kd_cells_w_nascent_counts_bulk_ref.rds")
# 1. Define pseudo-cell groups (e.g. by CRISPRi target gene / perturbation)
#    Adjust "target_gene" to whatever metadata column holds your grouping
Idents(obj) <- obj$entropy.gene
table(obj$entropy.gene)
table(obj$entropy.guide)
# 2. Pseudobulk (sum) counts per group, separately for each assay
total_counts <- AggregateExpression(obj, assays = "RNA", group.by = "entropy.gene",
                                     slot = "counts", return.seurat = FALSE)$RNA

nascent_counts <- AggregateExpression(obj, assays = "nascent", group.by = "entropy.gene",
                                       slot = "counts", return.seurat = FALSE)$nascent

# convert to base matrices immediately
total_counts   <- as.matrix(total_counts)
nascent_counts <- as.matrix(nascent_counts)

# make sure genes are aligned
common_genes <- intersect(rownames(total_counts), rownames(nascent_counts)) #25,217 genes
total_counts   <- total_counts[common_genes, ]
nascent_counts <- nascent_counts[common_genes, ]

# 3. Compute ratios
Rn_over_R <- nascent_counts / total_counts
Rp_over_R <- 1 - Rn_over_R

# 4. Mask invalid entries (Rn = 0 or Rn >= R, or R = 0)
valid <- (nascent_counts > 0) & (Rp_over_R > 0) & (total_counts > 0)

beta <- matrix(NA, nrow = nrow(total_counts), ncol = ncol(total_counts),
               dimnames = dimnames(total_counts))
beta[valid] <- -log(Rp_over_R[valid]) / t

alpha <- beta * total_counts

total_norm <- sweep(total_counts, 2, colSums(total_counts), "/") * 1e6
alpha_norm <- beta * total_norm

save(beta, alpha, alpha_norm, file = "kinetics_rates_per_perturbation_bulk_ref.RData")
load("kinetics_rates_per_perturbation_bulk_ref.RData")


### by guide
Idents(obj) <- obj$entropy.guide
table(obj$entropy.gene)
table(obj$entropy.guide)
# 2. Pseudobulk (sum) counts per group, separately for each assay
total_counts_guide <- AggregateExpression(obj, assays = "RNA", group.by = "entropy.guide",
                                     slot = "counts", return.seurat = FALSE)$RNA

nascent_counts_guide <- AggregateExpression(obj, assays = "nascent", group.by = "entropy.guide",
                                       slot = "counts", return.seurat = FALSE)$nascent

# convert to base matrices immediately
total_counts_guide   <- as.matrix(total_counts_guide)
nascent_counts_guide <- as.matrix(nascent_counts_guide)

# make sure genes are aligned
common_genes_guide <- intersect(rownames(total_counts_guide), rownames(nascent_counts_guide)) #25,217 genes
total_counts_guide   <- total_counts_guide[common_genes_guide, ]
nascent_counts_guide <- nascent_counts_guide[common_genes_guide, ]

# 3. Compute ratios
Rn_over_R_guide <- nascent_counts_guide / total_counts_guide
Rp_over_R_guide <- 1 - Rn_over_R_guide

# 4. Mask invalid entries (Rn = 0 or Rn >= R, or R = 0)
valid_guide <- (nascent_counts_guide > 0) & (Rp_over_R_guide > 0) & (total_counts_guide > 0)

beta_guide <- matrix(NA, nrow = nrow(total_counts_guide), ncol = ncol(total_counts_guide),
               dimnames = dimnames(total_counts_guide))
beta_guide[valid_guide] <- -log(Rp_over_R_guide[valid_guide]) / t

alpha_guide <- beta_guide * total_counts_guide

total_norm_guide <- sweep(total_counts_guide, 2, colSums(total_counts_guide), "/") * 1e6
alpha_norm_guide <- beta_guide * total_norm_guide

save(beta_guide, alpha_guide, alpha_norm_guide, file = "kinetics_rates_per_guide_bulk_ref.RData")
load("kinetics_rates_per_guide_bulk_ref.RData")
```
### t test w guide
```{r}
library(tidyverse)

beta_guide_long <- as.data.frame(beta_guide) %>%
  rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
  pivot_longer(-gene, names_to = "guide", values_to = "beta")

alpha_guide_long <- as.data.frame(alpha_norm_guide) %>%
  rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
  pivot_longer(-gene, names_to = "guide", values_to = "alpha")

rates_guide_long <- left_join(alpha_guide_long, beta_guide_long, by = c("gene", "guide")) %>%
  mutate(
    perturbation = gsub("g[1-6]$", "", guide),
    is_NT = perturbation == "NT"
  )

#Then test each perturbation versus NT per gene:

test_one_rate <- function(df, rate_col) {
    rate_sym <- rlang::sym(rate_col)

    df %>%
      filter(
        !is.na(!!rate_sym),
        is.finite(!!rate_sym),
        !!rate_sym > 0
      ) %>%
      group_by(gene) %>%
      group_modify(~ {
        gene_df <- .x

        nt_vals <- gene_df %>%
          filter(perturbation == "NT") %>%
          pull(!!rate_sym)

        perts <- setdiff(unique(gene_df$perturbation), "NT")

        map_dfr(perts, function(pert) {
          pert_vals <- gene_df %>%
            filter(perturbation == pert) %>%
            pull(!!rate_sym)

          if (length(pert_vals) < 2 || length(nt_vals) < 2) {
            return(tibble(
              perturbation = pert,
              log2FC = NA_real_,
              p_val = NA_real_,
              n_pert = length(pert_vals),
              n_NT = length(nt_vals)
            ))
          }

          pert_log <- log2(pert_vals)
          nt_log <- log2(nt_vals)

          p_val <- tryCatch(
            t.test(pert_log, nt_log)$p.value,
            error = function(e) NA_real_
          )

          tibble(
            perturbation = pert,
            log2FC = mean(pert_log) - mean(nt_log),
            p_val = p_val,
            n_pert = length(pert_vals),
            n_NT = length(nt_vals)
          )
        })
      }) %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      mutate(p_adj = p.adjust(p_val, method = "BH"))
  }

alpha_guide_tests <- test_one_rate(rates_guide_long, "alpha")
beta_guide_tests  <- test_one_rate(rates_guide_long, "beta")

#Then call significant genes with something like:

alpha_sig <- alpha_tests %>%
  filter(p_adj < 0.05, abs(log2FC) > 0.25)

beta_sig <- beta_tests %>%
  filter(p_adj < 0.05, abs(log2FC) > 0.25)
```
Use perturbation-level pseudobulk for the bootstrap, but sample cells within guides so guide composition is preserved. In each bootstrap iteration:

  - resample cells within each perturbation guide
  - sum RNA and nascent counts across the resampled cells
  - combine the 2 guides into one perturbation pseudobulk
  - combine the 3 NT guides into one NT pseudobulk
  - compute alpha, beta
  - compute perturbation vs NT log2FC

  So: the final bootstrap comparison is gene/perturbation-level, but the resampling is guide-aware.
### bootstrapping
```{r}

library(Seurat)
library(Matrix)
library(tidyverse)

t_label <- 2
B <- 1000
eps <- 1e-8

obj <- readRDS("seurat_objects/260811_kd_cells_w_nascent_counts.rds")

DefaultAssay(obj) <- "RNA"

rna_counts <- GetAssayData(obj, assay = "RNA", layer = "counts")
nascent_counts <- GetAssayData(obj, assay = "nascent", layer = "counts")

common_genes <- intersect(rownames(rna_counts), rownames(nascent_counts))
rna_counts <- rna_counts[common_genes, ]
nascent_counts <- nascent_counts[common_genes, ]

common_cells <- Reduce(intersect, list(
  colnames(rna_counts),
  colnames(nascent_counts),
  rownames(obj[[]])
))

meta <- obj[[]] %>%
  rownames_to_column("cell") %>%
  filter(
    cell %in% common_cells,
    entropy.gene != "Unassigned",
    !is.na(entropy.gene),
    !is.na(entropy.guide)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    perturbation = entropy.gene,
    guide = entropy.guide
  )

guides_by_pert <- split(meta$guide, meta$perturbation)
guides_by_pert <- lapply(guides_by_pert, unique)

perturbations <- setdiff(names(guides_by_pert), c("NT", "Unassigned"))

compute_rates <- function(total_vec, nascent_vec, t_label = 2) {
  Rn_over_R <- nascent_vec / total_vec
  Rp_over_R <- 1 - Rn_over_R

  valid <- nascent_vec > 0 & total_vec > 0 & Rp_over_R > 0

  beta <- rep(NA_real_, length(total_vec))
  names(beta) <- names(total_vec)

  beta[valid] <- -log(Rp_over_R[valid]) / t_label

  total_cpm <- total_vec / sum(total_vec) * 1e6
  alpha <- beta * total_cpm

  list(alpha = alpha, beta = beta)
}

bootstrap_one_group <- function(group_meta) {
  sampled_cells <- group_meta %>%
    group_split(guide) %>%
    map(~ sample(.x$cell, size = nrow(.x), replace = TRUE)) %>%
    unlist(use.names = FALSE)

  sampled_idx_rna <- match(sampled_cells, colnames(rna_counts))
  sampled_idx_nascent <- match(sampled_cells, colnames(nascent_counts))

  sampled_idx_rna <- sampled_idx_rna[!is.na(sampled_idx_rna)]
  sampled_idx_nascent <- sampled_idx_nascent[!is.na(sampled_idx_nascent)]

  total_vec <- Matrix::rowSums(rna_counts[, sampled_idx_rna, drop = FALSE])
  nascent_vec <- Matrix::rowSums(nascent_counts[, sampled_idx_nascent, drop = FALSE])

  compute_rates(total_vec, nascent_vec, t_label = t_label)
}

boot_results <- vector("list", length(perturbations) * B)
idx <- 1



for (pert in perturbations) {
  message("Bootstrapping ", pert)

  pert_meta <- meta %>% filter(perturbation == pert)
  nt_meta <- meta %>% filter(perturbation == "NT")

  for (b in seq_len(B)) {
    pert_rates <- bootstrap_one_group(pert_meta)
    nt_rates <- bootstrap_one_group(nt_meta)

    log2fc_alpha <- log2((pert_rates$alpha + eps) / (nt_rates$alpha + eps))
    log2fc_beta  <- log2((pert_rates$beta  + eps) / (nt_rates$beta  + eps))

    boot_results[[idx]] <- tibble(
      gene = common_genes,
      perturbation = pert,
      bootstrap = b,
      log2FC_alpha = log2fc_alpha,
      log2FC_beta = log2fc_beta
    )

    idx <- idx + 1
  }
}

boot_results <- bind_rows(boot_results)

#Then summarize bootstrap significance:

bootstrap_pval <- function(x) {
  x <- x[is.finite(x)]
  if (length(x) == 0) return(NA_real_)

  p_pos <- mean(x >= 0)
  p_neg <- mean(x <= 0)

  2 * min(p_pos, p_neg)
}

alpha_stats <- boot_results %>%
  group_by(gene, perturbation) %>%
  summarise(
    log2FC_alpha = median(log2FC_alpha, na.rm = TRUE),
    alpha_ci_low = quantile(log2FC_alpha, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
    alpha_ci_high = quantile(log2FC_alpha, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
    p_val_alpha = bootstrap_pval(log2FC_alpha),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(p_adj_alpha = p.adjust(p_val_alpha, method = "BH"))

beta_stats <- boot_results %>%
  group_by(gene, perturbation) %>%
  summarise(
    log2FC_beta = median(log2FC_beta, na.rm = TRUE),
    beta_ci_low = quantile(log2FC_beta, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
    beta_ci_high = quantile(log2FC_beta, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
    p_val_beta = bootstrap_pval(log2FC_beta),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(p_adj_beta = p.adjust(p_val_beta, method = "BH"))

rate_stats <- full_join(alpha_stats, beta_stats, by = c("gene", "perturbation"))

#Call significant changes:

alpha_sig <- rate_stats %>%
  filter(
    p_adj_alpha < 0.05,
    abs(log2FC_alpha) > 0.25,
    alpha_ci_low > 0 | alpha_ci_high < 0
  )

beta_sig <- rate_stats %>%
  filter(
    p_adj_beta < 0.05,
    abs(log2FC_beta) > 0.25,
    beta_ci_low > 0 | beta_ci_high < 0
  )

#And separately check guide consistency:

guide_total <- AggregateExpression(
  obj,
  assays = "RNA",
  group.by = "entropy.guide",
  slot = "counts",
  return.seurat = FALSE
)$RNA

guide_nascent <- AggregateExpression(
  obj,
  assays = "nascent",
  return.seurat = FALSE
)$nascent
```

```{r}
plot_rate_volcano <- function(rate_stats, perturbation_name, rate = "alpha",
                                fdr_cutoff = 0.05, lfc_cutoff = 0.25) {
    lfc_col <- paste0("log2FC_", rate)
    padj_col <- paste0("p_adj_", rate)

    rate_stats %>%
      filter(
        perturbation == perturbation_name,
        is.finite(.data[[lfc_col]]),
        is.finite(.data[[padj_col]])
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        significance = case_when(
          .data[[padj_col]] < fdr_cutoff & .data[[lfc_col]] > lfc_cutoff ~ "Up",
          .data[[padj_col]] < fdr_cutoff & .data[[lfc_col]] < -lfc_cutoff ~ "Down",
          TRUE ~ "NS"
        )
      ) %>%
      ggplot(aes(x = .data[[lfc_col]], y = -log10(.data[[padj_col]] + 1e-300))) +
      geom_point(aes(color = significance), alpha = 0.7, size = 1.3) +
      geom_vline(xintercept = c(-lfc_cutoff, lfc_cutoff), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
      geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(fdr_cutoff), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
      scale_color_manual(values = c(
        "Up" = "firebrick",
        "Down" = "dodgerblue",
        "NS" = "grey75"
      )) +
      theme_classic() +
      labs(
        title = paste(perturbation_name, rate, "rate changes"),
        x = paste0("median bootstrap log2FC ", rate, " vs NT"),
        y = "-log10(FDR)"
      )
  }

  plot_rate_volcano(rate_stats, "YTHDF2", rate = "beta")
  plot_rate_volcano(rate_stats, "YTHDF2", rate = "alpha")
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  plot_rate_heatmap <- function(rate_stats, rate = "alpha", n_genes = 50) {
    lfc_col <- paste0("log2FC_", rate)
    padj_col <- paste0("p_adj_", rate)

    top_genes <- rate_stats %>%
      filter(.data[[padj_col]] < 0.05, is.finite(.data[[lfc_col]])) %>%
      group_by(gene) %>%
      summarise(max_abs_lfc = max(abs(.data[[lfc_col]]), na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
      arrange(desc(max_abs_lfc)) %>%
      slice_head(n = n_genes) %>%
      pull(gene)

    rate_stats %>%
      filter(gene %in% top_genes) %>%
      ggplot(aes(x = perturbation, y = gene, fill = .data[[lfc_col]])) +
      geom_tile() +
      scale_fill_gradient2(
        low = "dodgerblue",
        mid = "white",
        high = "firebrick",
        midpoint = 0,
        na.value = "grey90"
      ) +
      theme_classic() +
      theme(
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6)
      ) +
      labs(
        title = paste("Top", rate, "rate changes"),
        x = NULL,
        y = NULL,
        fill = "log2FC"
      )
  }

  plot_rate_heatmap(rate_stats, rate = "alpha", n_genes = 50)
  plot_rate_heatmap(rate_stats, rate = "beta", n_genes = 50)
```
## matching betas across guides
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
load("kinetics_rates_per_guide_bulk_ref.RData")

eps <- 1e-8
lfc_cutoff <- 0.25

guide_to_pert <- function(x) gsub("g[0-9]+$", "", x)

beta_guide_lfc <- as.data.frame(beta_guide) %>%
  rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
  pivot_longer(-gene, names_to = "guide", values_to = "beta") %>%
  mutate(perturbation = guide_to_pert(guide)) %>%
  group_by(gene) %>%
  mutate(nt_beta_mean = mean(beta[perturbation == "NT"], na.rm = TRUE),
         log2FC_beta_vs_NT = log2((beta + eps) / (nt_beta_mean + eps))) %>%
  ungroup()

beta_concordance <- beta_guide_lfc %>%
  filter(perturbation != "NT", is.finite(log2FC_beta_vs_NT)) %>%
  group_by(gene, perturbation) %>%
  summarise(
    guides = paste(guide, collapse = ";"),
    n_guides_valid = n(),
    median_log2FC_beta_vs_NT = median(log2FC_beta_vs_NT),
    n_guides_same_direction_passing =
      sum(sign(log2FC_beta_vs_NT) == sign(median_log2FC_beta_vs_NT) &
          abs(log2FC_beta_vs_NT) >= lfc_cutoff),
    n_guides_opposite_direction_passing =
      sum(sign(log2FC_beta_vs_NT) == -sign(median_log2FC_beta_vs_NT) &
          abs(log2FC_beta_vs_NT) >= lfc_cutoff),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    reproducible = n_guides_valid >= 2 &
      n_guides_same_direction_passing >= 2 &
      n_guides_opposite_direction_passing == 0,
    direction = ifelse(
      median_log2FC_beta_vs_NT > 0,
      "increased_beta_faster_degradation",
      "decreased_beta_slower_degradation"
    )
  )

beta_concordance_match <- beta_concordance %>% dplyr::filter(reproducible == TRUE)

save(beta_concordance_match, beta_guide_lfc, file = "guide_betas_lfc_concordance_bulk_ref.RData")
load("guide_betas_lfc_concordance_bulk_ref.RData")
```

  Yes, the direction mostly makes sense.

  In /brahms/mascioi/RBP_screen/novaseq/260120_novaseq/260127_processing_pipeline_output.Rmd:2094, the “up lambda”
  sets are genes that go up in the RACK1/YTHDF2 perturbation fingerprint. If those genes are normally decayed by
  active RACK1/YTHDF2, then CRISPRi should inhibit decay, causing lower inferred degradation rate beta.

  That matches your beta sign convention in 260813_analysis.Rmd:1838: log2FC = mean(log2(beta_pert)) -
  mean(log2(beta_NT)). So negative beta log2FC means decreased beta, i.e. slower degradation after CRISPRi.

  Observed from beta_concordance_match:

  set                  matched  median beta log2FC  decreased beta  increased beta
  RACK1_up_lambda          70              -0.574          63/70           7/70
  RACK1_down_lambda        53               0.276          26/53          27/53
  YTHDF2_up_lambda         76              -0.512          61/76          15/76
  YTHDF2_down_lambda       51              -0.343          30/51          21/51

  Interpretation: the top positive RACK1 and YTHDF2 fingerprint genes show strong negative beta shifts in the
  matching CRISPRi perturbation. That is exactly what you’d expect if those transcripts are normally destabilized
  by active RACK1/YTHDF2: knockdown reduces decay, so beta goes down.

  The “down lambda” sets are less clean. RACK1 down genes are basically split, while YTHDF2 down genes still lean
  toward decreased beta. So the main mechanistic consistency is in the positive fingerprint genes, not
  symmetrically in the negative fingerprint genes.
  
  They are not just barely above zero. The discordant genes are a small minority, but their beta increases are
  moderate, with some around 2-fold.

  For RACK1_up_lambda, 7 genes showed reproducible increased beta:

  gene      lambda     beta log2FC   beta fold-change
  RPL9      0.0198       0.479          1.39x
  SLC29A3   0.0308       0.516          1.43x
  CCDC47    0.0220       0.558          1.47x
  ZBED5     0.0191       0.632          1.55x
  TBL1XR1   0.0281       0.636          1.55x
  DDR1      0.0208       0.972          1.96x
  TCEAL8    0.0370       1.117          2.17x

  For YTHDF2_up_lambda, 15 genes showed reproducible increased beta:

  gene      lambda     beta log2FC   beta fold-change
  MKI67     0.0327       0.346          1.27x
  HNRNPF    0.0555       0.353          1.28x
  IGFBP4    0.0658       0.439          1.36x
  ACTG1     0.0401       0.547          1.46x
  GRB10     0.0208       0.583          1.50x
  CTSC      0.0234       0.584          1.50x
  ELOVL6    0.0250       0.592          1.51x
  IMP3      0.0309       0.622          1.54x
  GART      0.0248       0.837          1.79x
  SETX      0.0205       0.888          1.85x
  MRPS24    0.0238       0.911          1.88x
  DACH1     0.0555       0.960          1.95x
  DERL2     0.0231       0.965          1.95x
  NFE2L3    0.0313       0.990          1.99x
  DSC2      0.0245       1.036          2.05x

  My read: not concerning for the overall interpretation, because the majority trend is still strongly decreased
  beta: 63/70 for RACK1 up-lambda and 61/76 for YTHDF2 up-lambda. But the discordant genes are real enough that I
  would not call them noise solely from effect size. They are moderate outliers, worth flagging individually,
  especially TCEAL8, DDR1, DSC2, NFE2L3, DERL2, DACH1, MRPS24, and SETX.
  
  
  Using the unfiltered top 200 lambda genes gives basically the same conclusion.

  set                         matched  median beta log2FC  decreased beta  increased beta
  RACK1_up_lambda_unfiltered       75             -0.593          68/75           7/75
  RACK1_down_lambda_unfiltered     51              0.276          25/51          26/51
  YTHDF2_up_lambda_unfiltered      71             -0.482          56/71          15/71
  YTHDF2_down_lambda_unfiltered    50             -0.329          26/50          24/50

  For the biologically relevant up-lambda sets, beta still mostly decreases after CRISPRi:

  - RACK1_up: 90.7% decreased beta
  - YTHDF2_up: 78.9% decreased beta

  The increased-beta outliers are still moderate, not tiny:

  RACK1_up increased-beta genes:
  SLC29A3    0.516 log2FC   1.43x
  DOCK2      0.622 log2FC   1.54x
  TBL1XR1    0.636 log2FC   1.55x
  SRGN       0.675 log2FC   1.60x
  LINC01029  0.910 log2FC   1.88x
  NIHCOLE    1.040 log2FC   2.06x
  TCEAL8     1.117 log2FC   2.17x

  YTHDF2_up increased-beta genes:
  MKI67      0.346 log2FC   1.27x
  HNRNPF     0.353 log2FC   1.28x
  NIBAN1     0.397 log2FC   1.32x
  IGFBP4     0.439 log2FC   1.36x
  ACTG1      0.547 log2FC   1.46x
  MCM6       0.575 log2FC   1.49x
  CTSC       0.584 log2FC   1.50x
  ELOVL6     0.592 log2FC   1.51x
  IMP3       0.622 log2FC   1.54x
  GART       0.837 log2FC   1.79x
  MRPS24     0.911 log2FC   1.88x
  DACH1      0.960 log2FC   1.95x
  DERL2      0.965 log2FC   1.95x
  NFE2L3     0.990 log2FC   1.99x
  DSC2       1.036 log2FC   2.05x

  So: the unfiltered sets strengthen the RACK1 pattern slightly and keep the YTHDF2 pattern similar. The minority
  increased-beta genes are real outliers by effect size, but they do not undermine the aggregate direction.
# nascent counts! - nova ref
## adding to seurat
```{r}
library(data.table)
library(Matrix)
library(Seurat)
library(BPCells)

nascent <- readRDS("seurat_objects/260904_guide_assigned_cells_lmix_both_self_and_RBP.rds")

nascent.count.files <- list.files(
  "gex_processing/nascent_count_nova_ref",
  full.names = TRUE
)

sampleID <- basename(nascent.count.files)
sampleID <- gsub("_nascent_counts.tsv.gz", "", sampleID)

cell.keep <- Cells(nascent)

triplets <- vector("list", length(nascent.count.files))

for (i in seq_along(nascent.count.files)) {
  print(paste0("Sample number ",i," of ",length(nascent.count.files)))
  dt <- fread(nascent.count.files[i])
  
  # Rename non-gene columns to sample-prefixed cell names
  count.cols <- setdiff(names(dt), "gene")
  setnames(
    dt,
    old = count.cols,
    new = paste0(sampleID[i], "_", count.cols)
  )

  # Keep only cells present in the Seurat object
  keep.cols <- intersect(names(dt), cell.keep)
  dt <- dt[, c("gene", keep.cols), with = FALSE]

  # Convert wide counts to long sparse triplets
  long <- melt(
    dt,
    id.vars = "gene",
    variable.name = "cell",
    value.name = "count",
    variable.factor = FALSE
  )

  # Keep only nonzero, non-missing values
  long <- long[!is.na(count) & count != 0]

  triplets[[i]] <- long
}
rm(dt, long, count.cols, keep.cols)

triplets <- rbindlist(triplets)

genes <- unique(triplets$gene)
cells <- cell.keep[cell.keep %in% unique(triplets$cell)]

nascent.sparse <- sparseMatrix(
  i = match(triplets$gene, genes),
  j = match(triplets$cell, cells),
  x = triplets$count,
  dims = c(length(genes), length(cells)),
  dimnames = list(genes, cells)
)

nascent[["nascentNova"]] <- CreateAssay5Object(counts = nascent.sparse)

VlnPlot(
  nascent,
  group.by = "entropy.label",
  features = c("nCount_RNA","nCount_nascentNova"),
  log = TRUE,
  pt.size = 0
)

rm(triplets)
gc()


saveRDS(nascent, "seurat_objects/260904_assigned_cells_w_nascent_counts_nova_ref.rds")

rm(nascent, nascent.sparse, nascent.count.files, cell.keep,cells,i,sampleID)
gc()
```

## calculating rates
uses the differential equations from perturbsci kinetics

This gives you beta (degradation rate) and alpha (synthesis rate) matrices, genes × pseudo-cell-groups, with NA for genes that failed the validity filter in that group.
```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(Matrix)

t <- 2  # hours of 4sU labeling
obj <- readRDS("seurat_objects/260904_assigned_cells_w_nascent_counts_nova_ref.rds")

kd.rbp <- subset(obj, lmix.RBP.model != "NP")
kd.rbp[["RNA"]]$counts <- as(kd.rbp[["RNA"]]$counts, "dgCMatrix")
gc()
kd.4sU <- subset(obj, lmix.model != "NP")
kd.4sU[["RNA"]]$counts <- as(kd.4sU[["RNA"]]$counts, "dgCMatrix")
gc()
################## RBP ########################
# 1. Define pseudo-cell groups (e.g. by CRISPRi target gene / perturbation)
#    Adjust "target_gene" to whatever metadata column holds your grouping
Idents(kd.rbp) <- kd.rbp$entropy.gene
table(kd.rbp$entropy.gene)
table(kd.rbp$entropy.guide)
# 2. Pseudobulk (sum) counts per group, separately for each assay
total_counts <- AggregateExpression(kd.rbp, assays = "RNA", group.by = "entropy.gene",
                                     slot = "counts", return.seurat = FALSE)$RNA

nascent_counts <- AggregateExpression(kd.rbp, assays = "nascentNova", group.by = "entropy.gene",
                                       slot = "counts", return.seurat = FALSE)$nascentNova

# convert to base matrices immediately
total_counts   <- as.matrix(total_counts)
nascent_counts <- as.matrix(nascent_counts)

# make sure genes are aligned
common_genes <- intersect(rownames(total_counts), rownames(nascent_counts)) #25,217 genes
total_counts   <- total_counts[common_genes, ]
nascent_counts <- nascent_counts[common_genes, ]

# 3. Compute ratios
Rn_over_R <- nascent_counts / total_counts
Rp_over_R <- 1 - Rn_over_R

# 4. Mask invalid entries (Rn = 0 or Rn >= R, or R = 0)
valid <- (nascent_counts > 0) & (Rp_over_R > 0) & (total_counts > 0)

beta_rbp <- matrix(NA, nrow = nrow(total_counts), ncol = ncol(total_counts),
               dimnames = dimnames(total_counts))
beta_rbp[valid] <- -log(Rp_over_R[valid]) / t

alpha_rbp <- beta_rbp * total_counts

total_norm <- sweep(total_counts, 2, colSums(total_counts), "/") * 1e6
alpha_rbp_norm <- beta_rbp * total_norm

save(beta_rbp, alpha_rbp, alpha_rbp_norm, file = "kinetics_rates_per_perturbation_nova_ref_rbp_kd.RData")
load("kinetics_rates_per_perturbation_nova_ref_rbp_kd.RData")


### by guide
Idents(kd.rbp) <- kd.rbp$entropy.guide
table(kd.rbp$entropy.gene)
table(kd.rbp$entropy.guide)
# 2. Pseudobulk (sum) counts per group, separately for each assay
total_counts_guide <- AggregateExpression(kd.rbp, assays = "RNA", group.by = "entropy.guide",
                                     slot = "counts", return.seurat = FALSE)$RNA

nascent_counts_guide <- AggregateExpression(kd.rbp, assays = "nascentNova", group.by = "entropy.guide",
                                       slot = "counts", return.seurat = FALSE)$nascentNova

# convert to base matrices immediately
total_counts_guide   <- as.matrix(total_counts_guide)
nascent_counts_guide <- as.matrix(nascent_counts_guide)

# make sure genes are aligned
common_genes_guide <- intersect(rownames(total_counts_guide), rownames(nascent_counts_guide)) #25,217 genes
total_counts_guide   <- total_counts_guide[common_genes_guide, ]
nascent_counts_guide <- nascent_counts_guide[common_genes_guide, ]

# 3. Compute ratios
Rn_over_R_guide <- nascent_counts_guide / total_counts_guide
Rp_over_R_guide <- 1 - Rn_over_R_guide

# 4. Mask invalid entries (Rn = 0 or Rn >= R, or R = 0)
valid_guide <- (nascent_counts_guide > 0) & (Rp_over_R_guide > 0) & (total_counts_guide > 0)

beta_rbp_guide <- matrix(NA, nrow = nrow(total_counts_guide), ncol = ncol(total_counts_guide),
               dimnames = dimnames(total_counts_guide))
beta_rbp_guide[valid_guide] <- -log(Rp_over_R_guide[valid_guide]) / t

alpha_rbp_guide <- beta_rbp_guide * total_counts_guide

total_norm_guide <- sweep(total_counts_guide, 2, colSums(total_counts_guide), "/") * 1e6
alpha_rbp_norm_guide <- beta_rbp_guide * total_norm_guide

save(beta_rbp_guide, alpha_rbp_guide, alpha_rbp_norm_guide, file = "kinetics_rates_per_guide_nova_ref_rbp_kd.RData")
load("kinetics_rates_per_guide_nova_ref_rbp_kd.RData")


################## nascent ########################

#    Adjust "target_gene" to whatever metadata column holds your grouping

nascent_counts <- nascent_counts[common_genes, ]

# 3. Compute ratios
Rn_over_R <- nascent_counts / total_counts

# 4. Mask invalid entries (Rn = 0 or Rn >= R, or R = 0)

load("kinetics_rates_per_perturbation_nova_ref_4sU_kd.RData")


### by guide
Idents(kd.4sU) <- kd.4sU$entropy.guide
table(kd.4sU$entropy.gene)
table(kd.4sU$entropy.guide)
# 2. Pseudobulk (sum) counts per group, separately for each assay

                                     slot = "counts", return.seurat = FALSE)$RNA

                                       slot = "counts", return.seurat = FALSE)$nascentNova

nascent_counts_guide <- nascent_counts_guide[common_genes_guide, ]

# 3. Compute ratios

valid_guide <- (nascent_counts_guide > 0) & (Rp_over_R_guide > 0) & (total_counts_guide > 0)
```

## matching betas across guides
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
load("kinetics_rates_per_guide_nova_ref_4sU_kd.RData")
load("kinetics_rates_per_guide_nova_ref_rbp_kd.RData")

eps <- 1e-8
lfc_cutoff <- 0.25

guide_to_pert <- function(x) gsub("g[0-9]+$", "", x)

beta_guide_rbp_lfc <- as.data.frame(beta_rbp_guide) %>%
  rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
  pivot_longer(-gene, names_to = "guide", values_to = "beta") %>%
  mutate(perturbation = guide_to_pert(guide)) %>%
  group_by(gene) %>%
  mutate(nt_beta_mean = mean(beta[perturbation == "NT"], na.rm = TRUE),
         log2FC_beta_vs_NT = log2((beta + eps) / (nt_beta_mean + eps))) %>%
  ungroup()

beta_rbp_concordance <- beta_guide_rbp_lfc %>%
  filter(perturbation != "NT", is.finite(log2FC_beta_vs_NT)) %>%
  group_by(gene, perturbation) %>%
  summarise(
    guides = paste(guide, collapse = ";"),
    n_guides_valid = n(),
    median_log2FC_beta_vs_NT = median(log2FC_beta_vs_NT),
    n_guides_same_direction_passing =
      sum(sign(log2FC_beta_vs_NT) == sign(median_log2FC_beta_vs_NT) &
          abs(log2FC_beta_vs_NT) >= lfc_cutoff),
    n_guides_opposite_direction_passing =
      sum(sign(log2FC_beta_vs_NT) == -sign(median_log2FC_beta_vs_NT) &
          abs(log2FC_beta_vs_NT) >= lfc_cutoff),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    reproducible = n_guides_valid >= 2 &
      n_guides_same_direction_passing >= 2 &
      n_guides_opposite_direction_passing == 0,
    direction = ifelse(
      median_log2FC_beta_vs_NT > 0,
      "increased_beta_faster_degradation",
      "decreased_beta_slower_degradation"
    )
  )

beta_rbp_concordance_match <- beta_rbp_concordance %>% dplyr::filter(reproducible == TRUE)

save(beta_rbp_concordance_match, beta_guide_rbp_lfc, file = "guide_betas_rbp_lfc_concordance_nova_ref.RData")
load("guide_betas_rbp_lfc_concordance_nova_ref.RData")


beta_guide_4sU_lfc <- as.data.frame(beta_4sU_guide) %>%
  rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
  pivot_longer(-gene, names_to = "guide", values_to = "beta") %>%
  mutate(perturbation = guide_to_pert(guide)) %>%
  group_by(gene) %>%
  mutate(nt_beta_mean = mean(beta[perturbation == "NT"], na.rm = TRUE),
         log2FC_beta_vs_NT = log2((beta + eps) / (nt_beta_mean + eps))) %>%
  ungroup()

beta_4sU_concordance <- beta_guide_4sU_lfc %>%
  filter(perturbation != "NT", is.finite(log2FC_beta_vs_NT)) %>%
  group_by(gene, perturbation) %>%
  summarise(
    guides = paste(guide, collapse = ";"),
    n_guides_valid = n(),
    median_log2FC_beta_vs_NT = median(log2FC_beta_vs_NT),
    n_guides_same_direction_passing =
      sum(sign(log2FC_beta_vs_NT) == sign(median_log2FC_beta_vs_NT) &
          abs(log2FC_beta_vs_NT) >= lfc_cutoff),
    n_guides_opposite_direction_passing =
      sum(sign(log2FC_beta_vs_NT) == -sign(median_log2FC_beta_vs_NT) &
          abs(log2FC_beta_vs_NT) >= lfc_cutoff),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    reproducible = n_guides_valid >= 2 &
      n_guides_same_direction_passing >= 2 &
      n_guides_opposite_direction_passing == 0,
    direction = ifelse(
      median_log2FC_beta_vs_NT > 0,
      "increased_beta_faster_degradation",
      "decreased_beta_slower_degradation"
    )
  )

beta_4sU_concordance_match <- beta_4sU_concordance %>% dplyr::filter(reproducible == TRUE)

save(beta_4sU_concordance_match, beta_guide_4sU_lfc, file = "guide_betas_4sU_lfc_concordance_nova_ref.RData")
load("guide_betas_4sU_lfc_concordance_nova_ref.RData")

#### alpha_norm
alpha_norm_guide_4sU_lfc <- as.data.frame(alpha_4sU_norm_guide) %>%
  rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
  pivot_longer(-gene, names_to = "guide", values_to = "alpha_norm") %>%
  mutate(perturbation = guide_to_pert(guide)) %>%
  group_by(gene) %>%
  mutate(nt_alpha_norm_mean = mean(alpha_norm[perturbation == "NT"], na.rm = TRUE),
         log2FC_alpha_norm_vs_NT = log2((alpha_norm + eps) / (nt_alpha_norm_mean + eps))) %>%
  ungroup()

alpha_norm_4sU_concordance <- alpha_norm_guide_4sU_lfc %>%
  filter(perturbation != "NT", is.finite(log2FC_alpha_norm_vs_NT)) %>%
  group_by(gene, perturbation) %>%
  summarise(
    guides = paste(guide, collapse = ";"),
    n_guides_valid = n(),
    median_log2FC_alpha_norm_vs_NT = median(log2FC_alpha_norm_vs_NT),
    n_guides_same_direction_passing =
      sum(sign(log2FC_alpha_norm_vs_NT) == sign(median_log2FC_alpha_norm_vs_NT) &
          abs(log2FC_alpha_norm_vs_NT) >= lfc_cutoff),
    n_guides_opposite_direction_passing =
      sum(sign(log2FC_alpha_norm_vs_NT) == -sign(median_log2FC_alpha_norm_vs_NT) &
          abs(log2FC_alpha_norm_vs_NT) >= lfc_cutoff),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    reproducible = n_guides_valid >= 2 &
      n_guides_same_direction_passing >= 2 &
      n_guides_opposite_direction_passing == 0,
    direction = ifelse(
      median_log2FC_alpha_norm_vs_NT > 0,
      "increased_alpha_norm_faster_synthesis",
      "decreased_alpha_norm_slower_synthesis"
    )
  )

alpha_norm_4sU_concordance_match <- alpha_norm_4sU_concordance %>% dplyr::filter(reproducible == TRUE)

save(alpha_norm_4sU_concordance_match, alpha_norm_guide_4sU_lfc, file = "guide_alpha_norm_4sU_lfc_concordance_nova_ref.RData")
load("guide_alpha_norm_4sU_lfc_concordance_nova_ref.RData")
```

```{r}
dir_cols <- c(

add_sig_test <- function(df, y_col) {
  whisker_pos <- df %>%
    group_by(Signature, Direction) %>%
    summarise(
      upper_whisker = boxplot.stats(.data[[y_col]])$stats[5],
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    group_by(Signature) %>%
    summarise(
      y.position = max(upper_whisker, na.rm = TRUE) +
        0.08 * diff(range(df[[y_col]], na.rm = TRUE)),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  df %>%
    group_by(Signature) %>%
    wilcox_test(as.formula(paste(y_col, "~ Direction"))) %>%
    adjust_pvalue(method = "BH") %>%
    add_significance("p.adj") %>%
    add_xy_position(x = "Signature", dodge = 0.8) %>%
    select(-y.position) %>%
    left_join(whisker_pos, by = "Signature")
}
```

```{r}
# Function to extract GI values for one vector
extract_GI <- function(genes, set_name) {
  m6A.GI.table %>%
    filter(gene_symbol %in% genes) %>%
    select(gene_symbol, m6A_GI_1, m6A_GI_2) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("m6A_GI_"),
                 names_to = "Input",
                 values_to = "GI") %>%
    mutate(Set = set_name)
}

add_sig_test <- function(df, y_col) {
  whisker_pos <- df %>%
    group_by(Signature, Direction) %>%
    summarise(
      upper_whisker = boxplot.stats(.data[[y_col]])$stats[5],
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    group_by(Signature) %>%
    summarise(
      y.position = max(upper_whisker, na.rm = TRUE) +
        0.08 * diff(range(df[[y_col]], na.rm = TRUE)),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  df %>%
    group_by(Signature) %>%
    wilcox_test(as.formula(paste(y_col, "~ Direction"))) %>%
    adjust_pvalue(method = "BH") %>%
    add_significance("p.adj") %>%
    add_xy_position(x = "Signature", dodge = 0.8) %>%
    select(-y.position) %>%
    left_join(whisker_pos, by = "Signature")
}
```

### ### pca on lfc betas then heatmap
#### not variable featuers from fingerprints
```{r}
load(file = "filtered_beta_guide_and_lfc_4sU_kd_for_low_counts.RData")

lfc_obj <- CreateSeuratObject(counts=beta_lfc_guide_matrix_filtered,data=beta_lfc_guide_matrix_filtered)
#lam_obj <- CreateSeuratObject(counts=guide.fingerprints$fingerprints$Lambdas,data=guide.fingerprints$fingerprints$Lambdas)
lfc_obj <- ScaleData(lfc_obj)
lfc_obj <- RunPCA(lfc_obj,features=rownames(lfc_obj),npcs=30)
emb <- lfc_obj@reductions$pca@cell.embeddings
alpha <- 0.7
sdev <- lfc_obj@reductions$pca@stdev          # per-PC standard deviation (sqrt of eigenvalue)
sdev <- sdev[seq_len(ncol(emb))]              # align length to the columns present
emb_rw <- sweep(emb, 2, sdev^alpha, "/")


## ============================================================
## 2-stage filtering of perturbations:
##   (1) PCA-embedding neighbor filter: max|r_pca| >= 0.6
##   (2) Raw-lambda neighbor filter:    max|r_raw| >= 0.2
## Plot ONE heatmap using PCA-embedding correlations for those
## passing BOTH filters.
## ============================================================

## --------------------------
## Knobs
## --------------------------
npcs          <- 30
min_abs_r_pca <- 0.01   # stage-1 (PCA space)
min_abs_r_raw <- 0.01  # stage-2 (raw lambdas)
hclust_method <- "average"
row_fontsize  <- 0.5

## --------------------------
## 1) Align genes + build Seurat + PCA (perturbations are "cells")
##    lambdas: genes x perturbations
## --------------------------
#genes_use <- rownames(guide.fingerprints$fingerprints$Lambdas)

#lambdas_mat <- as.matrix(guide.fingerprints$fingerprints$Lambdas[genes_use, , drop = FALSE])

genes_use <- rownames(beta_lfc_guide_matrix_filtered)

lfcs_mat <- as.matrix(beta_lfc_guide_matrix_filtered[genes_use, , drop = FALSE])

Z <- emb_rw  # izzy's weighted embeddings

## --------------------------
## 2) Stage-1 filter: PCA-embedding neighbors
## --------------------------
cor_pca_all <- cor(t(Z), method = "pearson")  # perturbation x perturbation
diag(cor_pca_all) <- NA_real_

max_abs_pca <- apply(abs(cor_pca_all), 1, max, na.rm = TRUE)
keep_pca    <- max_abs_pca >= min_abs_r_pca

message(
  "Stage-1 (PCA) kept ", sum(keep_pca), " / ", length(keep_pca),
  " with max|r_pca| >= ", min_abs_r_pca
)

if (sum(keep_pca) < 2) stop("Too few passed PCA neighbor filter. Lower min_abs_r_pca.")

perts_pca <- names(keep_pca)[keep_pca]

## --------------------------
## 3) Stage-2 filter: RAW lambda neighbors, applied within stage-1 set
## --------------------------
lfcs_stage1 <- lfcs_mat[, perts_pca, drop = FALSE]   # genes x perts (stage-1)
cor_raw_stage1 <- cor(lfcs_stage1, method = "pearson", use = "complete.obs")  # perts x perts
diag(cor_raw_stage1) <- NA_real_

max_abs_raw <- apply(abs(cor_raw_stage1), 1, max, na.rm = TRUE)
keep_raw    <- max_abs_raw >= min_abs_r_raw

message(
  "Stage-2 (RAW) kept ", sum(keep_raw), " / ", length(keep_raw),
  " (among stage-1) with max|r_raw| >= ", min_abs_r_raw
)

if (sum(keep_raw) < 2) stop("Too few passed raw-lambda neighbor filter. Lower min_abs_r_raw.")

perts_final <- names(keep_raw)[keep_raw]

## --------------------------
## 4) Final heatmap: PCA correlations (embedding space) for those passing BOTH
##    (recompute on the displayed set for clean quantiles/clustering)
## --------------------------
Z_final <- Z[perts_final, , drop = FALSE]
cor_pca_final <- cor(t(Z_final), method = "pearson")
diag(cor_pca_final) <- 0

hc <- hclust(as.dist(1 - cor_pca_final), method = hclust_method)

q  <- quantile(cor_pca_final, probs = c(0.01, 0.99), na.rm = TRUE)
lo <- max(-1, q[[1]])
hi <- min( 1, q[[2]])
diag(cor_pca_final) <- 1

#################################################
####### plotly version
# Reorder matrix according to your clustering
library(plotly)
#hc <- readRDS("/brahms/mascioi/RBP_screen/novaseq/260120_novaseq/strong_perturbations_hclust.rds")
#cor_pca_final <- readRDS("/brahms/mascioi/RBP_screen/novaseq/260120_novaseq/strong_perturbations_cor_pca_final.rds")

ord <- hc$order
cor_plot <- cor_pca_final[rev(ord), ord]
q  <- quantile(cor_pca_final, probs = c(0.01, 0.99), na.rm = TRUE)
lo <- max(-1, q[[1]])
hi <- min( 1, q[[2]])

pf <- plot_ly(
  x = colnames(cor_plot),
  y = rownames(cor_plot),
  z = cor_plot,
  type = "heatmap",
  colorscale = list(
    c(0, "blue"),
    c(0.5, "white"),
    c(1, "red")
  ),
  zmin = -1,
  zmax = 1,
  zmid = 0,
  hovertemplate = paste(
    "Guide X: %{x}<br>",
    "Guide Y: %{y}<br>",
    "Pearson r: %{z:.3f}<extra></extra>"
  )
) %>%
  layout(
    xaxis = list(
      showticklabels = FALSE
    ),
    yaxis = list(
      tickfont = list(size = 7)  # adjust scaling from ComplexHeatmap
    ),
    title = paste0("PCA-embedding correlations of filtered beta LFC (n=", nrow(cor_plot), ")")
  )
pf
```

```{r}
#### subset to top up and down
lambdas <- readRDS("../../novaseq/260120_novaseq/fingerprints/by.gene/lambdas.matrix.rds")
lambdas <- as.data.frame(lambdas)
lambdas <- lambdas %>% dplyr::select(unique(beta_pert_4sU_lfc$perturbation)[unique(beta_pert_4sU_lfc$perturbation) != "NT"])
variable.genes <- c()

for (i in 1:length(colnames(lambdas))) {
  pert <- colnames(lambdas)[i]
  up.lambda <- lambdas %>% dplyr::filter(.data[[pert]] > 0) %>% arrange(desc(.data[[pert]])) %>% head(n=100) %>% rownames
  down.lambda <- lambdas %>% dplyr::filter(.data[[pert]] < 0) %>% arrange(.data[[pert]]) %>% head(n=100) %>% rownames
  variable.genes <- union(variable.genes, c(up.lambda, down.lambda))
}



beta_pert_4sU_lfc_variable <- beta_pert_4sU_lfc %>% dplyr::filter(gene %in% variable.genes)

  select(gene, perturbation, log2FC_beta_vs_NT) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = perturbation,
    values_from = log2FC_beta_vs_NT
  )

save(beta_lfc_pert_variable, beta_lfc_pert_matrix_variable, file = "beta_lfc_filtered_low_counts_and_variable_genes_pert.RData")
```

```{r}
sig_levels <- c("METTL3_lambda", "YTHDF2_lambda", "RACK1_lambda")

)

dir_cols <- c(
  "Upregulated" = "goldenrod",
  "Downregulated" = "orchid4"
)

add_sig_test <- function(df, y_col) {
  whisker_pos <- df %>%
    group_by(Signature, Direction) %>%
    summarise(
      upper_whisker = boxplot.stats(.data[[y_col]])$stats[5],
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    group_by(Signature) %>%
    summarise(
      y.position = max(upper_whisker, na.rm = TRUE) +
        0.08 * diff(range(df[[y_col]], na.rm = TRUE)),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  df %>%
    group_by(Signature) %>%
    wilcox_test(as.formula(paste(y_col, "~ Direction"))) %>%
    adjust_pvalue(method = "BH") %>%
    add_significance("p.adj") %>%
    add_xy_position(x = "Signature", dodge = 0.8) %>%
    select(-y.position) %>%
    left_join(whisker_pos, by = "Signature")
}

# Mean beta per gene/perturbation from beta.m6A

    values_to = "beta"
  ) %>%
  mutate(perturbation = guide_to_pert(guide)) %>%
  filter(perturbation %in% c("METTL3", "YTHDF2", "RACK1")) %>%
  group_by(gene_symbol, perturbation) %>%
  summarise(beta = mean(beta, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# Same lambda-defined up/down gene sets as m6A.p, but y axis is beta.m6A

  tibble(

    Set = set_name,
    Signature = sub("_(up|down)_lambda$", "_lambda", set_name),
    Direction = ifelse(grepl("_up_", set_name), "Upregulated", "Downregulated"),
    perturbation = str_extract(set_name, "^[^_]+")
  )
}) %>%
  left_join(beta_m6A_long, by = c("gene_symbol", "perturbation")) %>%
  filter(is.finite(beta)) %>%
  mutate(Signature = factor(Signature, levels = sig_levels))

stat_beta <- add_sig_test(plot_df_beta, "beta")

beta.p <- ggplot(plot_df_beta, aes(x = Signature, y = beta, fill = Direction)) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.6, outlier.shape = NA, position = position_dodge(width = 0.8)) +
  stat_pvalue_manual(
    stat_beta,
    label = "p.adj.signif",
    tip.length = 0.01,
    bracket.size = 0.4,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = sig_labels) +

  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.title = element_blank()
  ) +
  labs(
```

```{r}
m6A.lambdas <- as.data.frame(m6A.lambdas)

RACK1.up.lambda <- m6A.lambdas %>% dplyr::filter(RACK1 > 0) %>% arrange(desc(RACK1)) %>% head(n = 200) %>% rownames()
RACK1.down.lambda <- m6A.lambdas %>% dplyr::filter(RACK1 < 0) %>% arrange(RACK1) %>% head(n = 200) %>% rownames()

YTHDF2.down.lambda <- m6A.lambdas %>% dplyr::filter(YTHDF2 < 0) %>% arrange(YTHDF2) %>% head(n = 200) %>% rownames()

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(purrr)

# Put all vectors into a named list
gene_sets <- list(
  METTL3_up_lambda    = METTL3.up.lambda,
  METTL3_down_lambda  = METTL3.down.lambda,
  RACK1_up_lambda  = RACK1.up.lambda,
  RACK1_down_lambda= RACK1.down.lambda,
  YTHDF2_up_lambda  = YTHDF2.up.lambda,
  YTHDF2_down_lambda= YTHDF2.down.lambda
)

# Function to extract GI values for one vector
extract_GI <- function(genes, set_name) {
  m6A.GI.table %>%
    filter(gene_symbol %in% genes) %>%
    select(gene_symbol, m6A_GI_1, m6A_GI_2) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("m6A_GI_"),
                 names_to = "Input",
                 values_to = "GI") %>%
    mutate(Set = set_name)
}

# Apply across all gene sets
plot_df <- imap_dfr(gene_sets, extract_GI)

# Make labels cleaner
plot_df$Input <- recode(plot_df$Input,
                        m6A_GI_1 = "m6A Gene Index Rep 1",
                        m6A_GI_2 = "m6A Gene Index Rep 2")


plot_df <- plot_df %>%
  mutate(Direction = ifelse(grepl("up", Set), "Upregulated", "Downregulated"))

# Order sets so ups come first, downs second
plot_df$Set <- factor(plot_df$Set,
                      levels = c("RACK1_up_lambda", "METTL3_up_lambda", "YTHDF2_up_lambda", "RACK1_down_lambda", "METTL3_down_lambda", "YTHDF2_down_lambda"))




plot_df_avg <- plot_df %>%
  group_by(gene_symbol, Set, Direction) %>%
  summarise(GI = mean(GI, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Factor = str_extract(Set, "^[^_]+"))  # pulls "YTHDF2" from "YTHDF2_up_lambda"

plot_df_avg$Signature <- sub("_(up|down)_lambda$", "_lambda", plot_df_avg$Set)

plot_df_avg$Signature <- factor(
  plot_df_avg$Signature,
  levels = c(
    "METTL3_lambda",
    "YTHDF2_lambda",
    "RACK1_lambda"
  )
)


library(dplyr)
library(rstatix)
library(ggpubr)
library(dplyr)
library(rstatix)
library(ggpubr)

# Upper whisker used by geom_boxplot: highest non-outlier value
whisker_pos <- plot_df_avg %>%
  group_by(Signature, Direction) %>%
  summarise(
    upper_whisker = boxplot.stats(GI)$stats[5],
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(Signature) %>%
  summarise(
    y.position = max(upper_whisker, na.rm = TRUE) + 0.75,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

stat_test <- plot_df_avg %>%
  group_by(Signature) %>%
  wilcox_test(GI ~ Direction) %>%
  adjust_pvalue(method = "BH") %>%
  add_significance("p.adj") %>%
  add_xy_position(x = "Signature", dodge = 0.8) %>%
  select(-y.position) %>%
  left_join(whisker_pos, by = "Signature")




sig_levels <- c("METTL3_lambda", "YTHDF2_lambda", "RACK1_lambda")

sig_labels <- c(
  METTL3_lambda = "METTL3\n(writer)",
  YTHDF2_lambda = "YTHDF2\n(decay reader)",
  RACK1_lambda = "RACK1"
)

dir_cols <- c(
  "Upregulated" = "goldenrod",
  "Downregulated" = "orchid4"
)

add_sig_test <- function(df, y_col) {
  whisker_pos <- df %>%
    group_by(Signature, Direction) %>%
    summarise(
      upper_whisker = boxplot.stats(.data[[y_col]])$stats[5],
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    group_by(Signature) %>%
    summarise(
      y.position = max(upper_whisker, na.rm = TRUE) +
        0.08 * diff(range(df[[y_col]], na.rm = TRUE)),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  df %>%
    group_by(Signature) %>%
    wilcox_test(as.formula(paste(y_col, "~ Direction"))) %>%
    adjust_pvalue(method = "BH") %>%
    add_significance("p.adj") %>%
    add_xy_position(x = "Signature", dodge = 0.8) %>%
    select(-y.position) %>%
    left_join(whisker_pos, by = "Signature")
}

# Mean alpha per gene/perturbation from alpha.m6A
alpha_m6A_long <- alpha.m6A %>%
  rownames_to_column("gene_symbol") %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -gene_symbol,
    names_to = "guide",
    values_to = "alpha"
  ) %>%
  mutate(perturbation = guide_to_pert(guide)) %>%
  filter(perturbation %in% c("METTL3", "YTHDF2", "RACK1")) %>%
  group_by(gene_symbol, perturbation) %>%
  summarise(alpha = mean(alpha, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# Same lambda-defined up/down gene sets as m6A.p, but y axis is alpha.m6A
plot_df_alpha <- imap_dfr(gene_sets, function(genes, set_name) {
  tibble(
    gene_symbol = genes,
    Set = set_name,
    Signature = sub("_(up|down)_lambda$", "_lambda", set_name),
    Direction = ifelse(grepl("_up_", set_name), "Upregulated", "Downregulated"),
    perturbation = str_extract(set_name, "^[^_]+")
  )
}) %>%
  left_join(alpha_m6A_long, by = c("gene_symbol", "perturbation")) %>%
  filter(is.finite(alpha)) %>%
  mutate(Signature = factor(Signature, levels = sig_levels))

stat_alpha <- add_sig_test(plot_df_alpha, "alpha")

alpha.p <- ggplot(plot_df_alpha, aes(x = Signature, y = alpha, fill = Direction)) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.6, outlier.shape = NA, position = position_dodge(width = 0.8)) +
  stat_pvalue_manual(
    stat_alpha,
    label = "p.adj.signif",
    tip.length = 0.01,
    bracket.size = 0.4,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = sig_labels) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = dir_cols) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.title = element_blank()
  ) +
  labs(
    y = "Synthesis Rate (alpha_norm)",
    x = NULL,
    title = "Normalized synthesis rates for up or down regulated genes (filter out <20 total counts)"
  )

alpha.p
pdf("plots/260909_alpha_norms_vs_up_down_reg_RACK1_and_m6A_sub_for_nascent_perts_filter_less_than_20_total_counts.pdf", height = 4.5, width = 8)
alpha.p

# Split genes by alpha LFC up/down, then plot m6A GI levels on y axis.
# This mirrors the lambda plot by taking the strongest 200 positive and 200 negative genes.
alpha_lfc_gene_sets <- alpha_lfc_long %>%
  group_by(perturbation) %>%
  group_modify(~ bind_rows(
    .x %>%
      filter(alpha_lfc > 0) %>%
      arrange(desc(alpha_lfc)) %>%
      slice_head(n = 200) %>%
      mutate(Direction = "Increased Synthesis"), # Upregulated
    .x %>%
      filter(alpha_lfc < 0) %>%
      arrange(alpha_lfc) %>%
      slice_head(n = 200) %>%
      mutate(Direction = "Decreased Synthesis") # Downregulated
  )) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    Signature = factor(paste0(perturbation, "_lambda"), levels = sig_levels)
  )

m6A_GI_by_gene <- m6A.GI.table %>%
  filter(gene_symbol %in% GI.genes) %>%
  group_by(gene_symbol) %>%
  summarise(
    GI = mean(c(m6A_GI_1, m6A_GI_2), na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

plot_df_alpha_lfc_split_m6A <- alpha_lfc_gene_sets %>%
  left_join(m6A_GI_by_gene, by = "gene_symbol") %>%
  filter(is.finite(GI))

stat_alpha_lfc_split_m6A <- add_sig_test(plot_df_alpha_lfc_split_m6A, "GI")

dir_cols_lfc <- c(
  "Increased Synthesis" = "goldenrod",

)

alpha.lfc.split.m6A.p <- ggplot(

) +
```
